objective: Build the nodal admittance matrix (Ybus) from explicit branch and shunt network data.

title.en: REL-TASK-047 — Build Ybus from network data
title.ru: REL-TASK-047 — Построение Ybus по данным сети

objective.en: Build the bus admittance matrix from line impedances, line charging, and bus shunts.
objective.ru: Постройте матрицу узловых проводимостей по сопротивлениям линий, зарядной проводимости линий и шунтам узлов.

instructions.en: Use the network field. For each branch, compute y = 1 / (r + jx), add y + j*b/2 to both terminal diagonal entries, and add -y to the two off-diagonal entries. Then add each explicit shunt g + jb to its bus diagonal. Return buses in the exact task order and a complex Ybus matrix as {re, im} entries.
instructions.ru: Используйте поле network. Для каждой ветви вычислите y = 1 / (r + jx), добавьте y + j*b/2 в обе диагональные ячейки конечных узлов и -y в две внедиагональные ячейки. Затем добавьте каждый явный шунт g + jb в диагональ соответствующего узла. Верните buses в точном порядке задачи и комплексную матрицу Ybus в виде элементов {re, im}.

submission_schema.buses: list of bus ids in the task order
submission_schema.ybus: square matrix; each entry is {"re": float, "im": float}

hard_constraints: Submission must contain buses and ybus.
Submitted bus order must exactly match network.buses.
Ybus must be square with one row and column per bus.
Each entry must match the independently recomputed admittance matrix within numeric_tolerance.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted matrix satisfies shape and numerical constraints.

metrics.name: max_abs_error
metrics.description: Maximum complex absolute error against the independently recomputed Ybus.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: 1.0 for feasible submissions; partial credit decreases with maximum numerical error.
